title: QuestionAndAnswer
description: QuestionAndAnswer is a unique mod for Minecraft (Fabric) that turns your server into an intelligent game show! The mod is perfect for parties, streams, educational projects and just fun gatherings with friends.
body:
If you don't understand how the mod works, go to the **[WIKI](https://t.me/zdev_wiki/5)**

Main functions

- **Quiz with automatic construction:** Players answer questions, and their bridges are built according to the letters of the answer.
- **Flexible setup:** Everything from questions to effects and messages can be configured in a single file.
- **Continuation of construction:** Bridges continue to be built from where they left off until the round is stopped.
- **Reset progress:** Bridges and positions are reset only when the round is stopped or completely cleared.
- **Supports up to 4 players simultaneously** (can be expanded if necessary).

 How to set up

1. **Install the mod** as a regular Fabric mod (place the jar file in the mods folder).
2. **Configure the `config.json` file:**
- Add your questions to the `"questions"` array.
   - Specify the starting positions of the players in the "startPositions".
   - Customize bridge blocks, effects, messages and other parameters to your liking.
3. **Start the server or a single player game with Fabric.**
4. **Use the commands:**
- `/setpos` — each player must set his starting position.
   - `/question [question]` — the moderator asks a question.
   - `/stopround' — stop the round and reset the bridges.

**Download the mod, set up questions and arrange a real intellectual show right in Minecraft!**
